chunks: He said: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad al-Katib informed me from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Za'farani, who informed from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who informed from Abu Ismail al-Attar, who informed from Ibn Luhai'ah, from Abu al-Aswad, from Urwa ibn al-Zubayr, who said:

When the people pledged allegiance to Abu Bakr, Fatimah the daughter of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family, came out and stood at her door and said: 'Never have I witnessed a day like this. They have indeed set the worst precedent. They left their Prophet, may Allah bless him and his family, as a corpse in our midst and monopolized the matter without us.'

key_terms.استبدوا: they monopolized / they acted independently - seized authority without consultation
key_terms.بايع: pledged allegiance - a formal oath of loyalty to a new leader
key_terms.جنازة: corpse / funeral bier - the Prophet's unburied body

ai.seo_question: What did Fatimah say when the people pledged allegiance to Abu Bakr?
ai.summary: This narration, reported through Urwa ibn al-Zubayr, describes Fatimah's reaction immediately after the people pledged allegiance to Abu Bakr at Saqifah. Her words express grief over two simultaneous acts: abandoning the Prophet's body unburied while rushing to settle the question of political succession, and excluding the Prophet's family from the decision. This hadith is a central text in Shia discourse on the events following the Prophet's death.
